limitations.claim: This is a manually implemented Python semantic port, not a mechanical extraction of executable Rust logic or a proof of full equivalence.
context: Non-Linux timezone detection still uses TZ, /etc/localtime and Python's timezone name; the pinned iana-time-zone platform APIs outside Linux are not ported.
execution: custom network or filesystem sandbox profiles
resources: remote MCP HTTP/OAuth and remote execution environments
all large skill-catalog alias/compaction edge cases
all MCP JSON-schema sanitation edge cases
limitations.verification: Tests establish only the traces they cover; asset/source verification establishes provenance and data equality, not semantic equivalence.
images: Original bytes supported only for PNG/JPEG/WebP within native size/patch budgets
TIFF/GIF re-encoding and resizing branches reject until native encoders/filter are ported
tool_search: Equal BM25 scores retain registration order; upstream inherits Rust HashSet iteration and has no stable tie order.
custom_agent_roles: Custom role TOML rejects relative typed paths in nested config_file, cwd, model_instructions_file, experimental_compact_prompt_file, model_catalog_json, js_repl_node_path, sqlite_home, log_dir, export_dir, load_path, writable_roots and js_repl_node_module_dirs fields.
memory: The pinned app-server has a phase1 extraction / phase2 consolidation pipeline; ephemeral exec does not trigger it. That persistent-session writer pipeline is not ported. Python supports summary/read tools and explicit append-only notes; runtime note persistence is an adapter option outside Snapshot.
code_mode: Python-controlled Node V8 module workers require a local Node executable. Full equivalence across V8 versions and every runtime edge case is not proven.
Malformed argument diagnostics are not byte-identical for every JSON/serde error.
Audio output budget currently decodes WAV only; other native codecs are not covered.
JavaScript timeouts above 2^31-1 milliseconds currently use the Node timer cap.
sessions: Subagent persistence is within the current run; cross-process restoration and the full native rollout database are not ported.
Fork history does not replay rollback or legacy compaction rollout events.
Cached turns can change compatible model/effort/budgets; actor/tool protocol, initialized resource settings and environment changes reject explicitly.
features.rollout_budget shared parent/child task budgets, reminders and exceeded-budget termination
shell_snapshot: POSIX shell snapshots use the filesystem rollout lookup; integration with the unported persistent state DB is not available.
Windows shell snapshots remain outside the supported shell/PTY/process execution backend.
